title: Unique Ziplock bag organizer w/cutters to hang on a wall or put in a super large drawer but TRICKY
text:
Unique Ziplock bag organizer w/cutters to hang on a wall or put in a super large drawer but TRICKY. This is a unique six-compartment organizer with two compartments for a box of plastic wrap (or wax paper) and foil with a cutter each and four other compartments for different types of Ziplock bags (quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack). The labels for the bags are etched into the bamboo. There are also two cutter strips included and I installed them in their tracks. The cutting strips cut well as can be seen from my photo.

What is unique about this organizer is that it is expandable. The sides expand to allow me to put the boxes into the organizer instead of just the rolls of foil, plastic wrap, or wax paper. I did not have a box of foil or plastic wrap, so I took a photo with a box of bags in one of the compartments. I also tested the cutting strips with a piece of wax paper ( see photo) and they cut well.

The unit does not open so the bags have to be loaded through their holes.

This can be hung on the wall or be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it--the drawer must be very large. No rubberized circles are proved, which is a negative as that is needed to attach to the underside to keep this from sliding around or scratching a drawer or wall. Also, no screws with plastic mollies are provided for hanging, which is another disappointment. There are two holes if using this contracted and for the bags only or four holes if using fully expanded to expose the six compartments.

Overall, this is an excellent organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. It is definitely a quality unit and a very heavy one at that. However, the BIGGEST NEGATIVE is also its most unique feature. The expandable sections cannot be expanded on the wall. This means, one has to set the expansion distance before securing to the wall. It is also impossible to load and unload the boxes in the side panels when it is on the wall, simply because it cannot be expanded. If they cut a channel or groove where the screw goes, then I would be able to slide it open and closed at least a little bit. It is very possible this has to be removed from the wall every time a box needs to be loaded. Also, if the box size changes, that presents a problem when the distance is already set for a unit that was previously hung.

The current price of $31.99 ($39.99 minus 20%) is on the high side of competitively priced for this. There are many other Ziplock bag organizer options available on the market such as this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]] or an individual heavy plastic set like [[ASIN:B09THNTBGX this]]. For a cheaper unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]] but no screws are provided with that one. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires. I personally like these other ones a little better than this one.
